description:
Private AI chat that runs language models on your phone, offline

Private AI that runs on your phone.

NekoChat chats with language models running entirely on your device, through its own C++ inference engine. Your conversations never leave the phone, and there are no accounts, ads or analytics. The internet is only used when you choose to download a model.

Features

  • Models: GPT-2, Qwen3 (0.6B and up) and IBM Granite 4.0-H (350M, 1B), from .safetensors or PyTorch checkpoints. Outputs match the Hugging Face reference token for token
  • Your own engine: runs on Vulkan, OpenGL ES 3.1 or the CPU (NEON). A GPU is only used after it passes a self-test
  • Weight precision: FP16, FP8 or FP4, quantized while the model loads. FP8 halves the memory with nearly the same answers
  • Downloads: one-tap models from Hugging Face, or any public repository. Resumes where it stopped. Or just pick a folder of models you already have
  • Chats: as many as you like, each with its own temperature, top-k, top-p, repetition penalty, reply length, seed and persona. Redo a reply or edit your message
  • Voice input: tap the mic and talk. Granite Speech turns it into text on the phone (English, downloaded on request); the recording never leaves the device
  • Read aloud: replies and actions spoken by Kokoro-82M, a text-to-speech model that also runs on the phone (downloaded on request), or by the phone's own voice
  • Memory indicator: see what the model, chat memory and the app use
  • Themes: Rose, Ocean and Gothic Pink (built to WCAG 2.2 AA contrast)

Models are not included; NekoChat downloads them from Hugging Face when you ask, or reads them from a folder you choose. Small models (350M to 1B parameters) run comfortably on phones with 4 GB of RAM or more.

NekoChat is free software under the GNU General Public License v3. arm64 devices only.
